triples.name: supply gap limits lifting the NPP ban
triples.description: The four existing plants deliver {num:36 %} of Swiss electricity and almost half of the winter electricity; the last one (Leibstadt) is expected to stop around 2044, while demand rises to about {num:76 TWh} by 2050. Without new plants the winter net import grows to {num:7.5 TWh} in 2050; one EPR cuts it to {num:3.2 TWh}. {source:BAK economiesuisse study 2026}
